sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Insomnia is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good day to you, mercenary. Very soon I will have a night-time meeting on a very important matter. Unfortunately, according to my intelligence in the region, the number of night sorties of your, uh, colleagues has noticeably increased. I feel that these are the same people who do not risk operating in the daytime. I want you to deal with them. These criminals cannot disrupt my work."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text:
- This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.
- Must reach Loyalty Level 4 with Peacekeeper to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 40 targets in the time period of 21:00-06:00 on Streets of Tarkov, Lighthouse, Reserve, Ground Zero or Shoreline

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +1.5
- Dollars
  - Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 3,368 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× CENS ProFlex DX5 tactical earplug
- Unlocks purchase of CENS ProFlex DX5 tactical earplug at Peacekeeper LL4
- Unlocks barter for SAPI level III+ ballistic plate at Peacekeeper LL4
- +2 Levels for Aim Drills
- +4 levels for Submachine Guns
"Good work, my friend! Everything went according to the plan."
